messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert — page P12345 fired for service=embed-service-eu, alert=latency_p95_high. p95 now 1.2s -> 2.8s over 10m. Autopager: triggered.
sre_mike: acked. I'm on it. Starting checks.
eng_jess: thanks. any region tag? EU?
sre_mike: yes EU (embed-prod-eu). Noticing spike after 23:10 UTC, coincides with canary rollout embed-v2.3.1. Telemetry:
```
metric: embed_service.p95
10:55 -> 700ms
23:10 -> 2.6s
p99 -> 5.8s
```
sre_mike: running `redwoodctl rollout status embed-prod-eu` now.
sre_mike: logs show increased decode time from model: `decode_ms` bump for v2.3.1: 350ms -> 1200ms
eng_runtime_anna: confirmed, the canary has a different attention kernel that regresses on longer contexts. Rolling back canary to v2.3.0 recommended.
sre_mike: quick mitigation: 1) pause canary 2) route traffic for embed-route /v1/embeddings to fallback model `embed-v2-small` 3) scale pool +2 replicas.
sre_mike: running commands:
```
redwoodctl rollout pause embed-canary --region eu
redwoodctl routes update embed-route --model embed-v2-small --region eu
redwoodctl scale pool embed-prod-eu --replicas +2
```
incident-bot: Action logged: rollout paused by @sre_mike. Route update submitted.
product_liz: any customer impact? which customers hit the p95? Quick list please.
sre_mike: querying recent requests by tenant. Top impacted: tenant:acme-corp (heavy-batch embeddings), tenant:searchify. They're seeing latency + timeout retries. Notified SEs: @product_liz and @eng_jess.
eng_jess: SEs confirm increased retry rates, some user-facing UI errors for acme-corp. Alerting CS to prepare communication.
sre_mike: after routing to embed-v2-small p95 dropped to 800ms in 4m. p99 to 1.6s. Monitoring.
oncall_rotation: thx. I'll take the rest of the incident, will follow up in 30m for handoff. If metrics re-spike, DM and I'll wake up eng-runtime.
eng_runtime_anna: we'll do a revert and open a regression PR template for the attention kernel behavior. Investigating root cause.
sre_mike: marking as acknowledged and mitigated for now. closing autopager but keeping monitoring for 1h. tagging runbook: runbook.latency-embed -> step 4 rollback.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page acknowledged by sre_mike. Status: mitigated -> monitoring.
oncall_rotation: handoff noted. leaving notes:
- paused canary embed-v2.3.1 (rollback required)
- route switched to embed-v2-small
- scaled pool +2
- tenants impacted: acme-corp, searchify (notified)
- next: eng-runtime to revert and post root-cause

I'll update status channel + incident doc.
sre_mike: thanks, will keep an eye. :thumbsup:
